title: Classroom ventilation change proposed after a hypothetical CO2 observation
description: An operator receives an unverified classroom carbon dioxide reading and proposes changing ventilation settings. The reading is illustrative, not a health threshold or control instruction.

observation.description: Hypothetical classroom CO2 reading; no independent instrument verification

evidence.continuity: No signed provenance or custody record supplied

authority.authority_relationship: No verified delegation for control change
authority.applicable_policy: Site-specific control policy not independently verified

lesson: A numerical reading and an asserted operator role do not establish admissible evidence, standing or authorization to change equipment.
boundary_notes: Do not treat CO2 example value as a regulatory or clinical threshold.
No connection to equipment or autonomous control.
All entries are fictional claims; nonempty fields remain unverified.
A trusted signature alone would not establish admissibility or execution authority.
